content.text: All 180 error tests pass. Now let me harden `run.sh` and stdin handling.

arguments.command:
cat > /app/submission/run.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Entry point: reads one JSON request on stdin, writes one JSON response on stdout.
set -eu
DIR=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
cd "$DIR"
exec python3 -B main.py
EOF
chmod +x /app/submission/run.sh
cd /app/submission && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('main.py').read()
old = '''def main():
    raw = sys.stdin.buffer.read(MAX_INPUT_BYTES + 1)
    try:'''
new = '''def read_stdin():
    stream = sys.stdin.buffer
    raw = stream.read(MAX_INPUT_BYTES + 1)
    if raw is None:
        return b""
    if len(raw) > MAX_INPUT_BYTES:
        # Drain the rest so the writer never sees a broken pipe, then report.
        try:
            while stream.read(1 << 20):
                pass
        except Exception:
            pass
    return raw


def main():
    try:
        raw = read_stdin()
    except Exception:
        raw = b""
    try:'''
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('main.py','w').write(src)
EOF
